calculation.description: Ranks assets that underperformed the contemporaneous equal-weight 15-asset 20-day return basket, favoring larger negative residuals for mean reversion while scaling by each asset's 20-day realized volatility. The peer mean is computed cross-sectionally at each date using available tradable assets.

validation.period: 2020-01-01 through 2034-03-29 cutoff; forward 10-day observations available through 2034-03-15
validation.regime_notes: 10-day IC was positive in 2025-2026 (+0.09978061), 2027-2029 (+0.02305010), and 2030-2034 (+0.03475437). ICIR for those regimes was +0.283316, +0.095738, and +0.138254 respectively. The 20-day decay was stronger (+0.03803915), while 40-day predictive power faded (+0.00179646). Interpret uncertainty conservatively because the cross-section is only 15 assets, despite the long date history.
